ux review · closet v3
Craft and flow
Second pass: legibility, tap targets, and the two flows that carry the most weight.
06
Mono type is doing content's job, at 9px
Wear counts, dates, occasion names, filter chips and button labels are all 9–11px JetBrains Mono. Below any legible floor on a phone, and the chips are ~20px tall — under half the 44px minimum.
v4
Poppins sentence case for anything readable, Space Mono reserved for true metadata (dates, counts). Pills are 40–46px.
07
Logging is a 1450px form with invisible selection
Pick from a grid with no selected state, scroll past a date row, then twelve 9.5px occasion tags, then save. You never see what you've assembled.
v4
Two sheets. A tray at the top shows the look building up; tiles get a ring and a check. Then date, occasion, an optional note.
08
Suggest asks four questions to do one thing
Occasion, anchor item, weather panel and a 1–5 formality selector described as 'learned from history' — if it's learned, don't ask for it. Then results arrive as OPTION 1/2/3 radio buttons over five 60px thumbnails, so the options can't be compared.
v4
One question — where are you off to. Weather is shown as context, formality is invisible. Three full-width swipeable cards with page dots.
09
Item detail is a dead end
A spec sheet: nine attributes as mono key/value pairs, no action. You can look at a piece but not do anything with it.
v4
Wear it today and Save to idea sit under the stats. Warmth and formality become dot scales, and a 'worn with' row links out to real outfits.
10
Statistics don't compare anything
Three near-identical top-N lists with counts in brown text. 14× tells you nothing about relative frequency, and nothing here is actionable.
v4
Bars, a composition strip and month columns. Plus 'barely worn' — the one statistic that changes behaviour.
11
It isn't the brand
Geist, JetBrains Mono and an invented #9C5544 accent read as engineering telemetry. Pelamarela is softly creative, warm, hand-made, sentence case.
v4
Syne, Poppins, Space Mono; paper, peach, rose, real cocoa. Soft radii, the dotted grid behind empty states, the wave as a quiet flourish.
